versions.subject: Rules persitence by exploiting Outlook or Exchange
versions.detection:
selection1:
  EventID:
    - 13
  TargetObject|contains: 
    - 'Software\Microsoft\Office\'
    - 'Outlook\WebView\'
  TargetObject|endswith: 'URL'
selection2:
  TargetObject|contains: 
    - 'Calendar'
    - 'Inbox'
condition: selection1 and 1 of selection2
versions.spl: EventID=13 TargetObject IN ("*Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\*", "*Outlook\\WebView\\*") TargetObject="*URL" TargetObject IN ("*Calendar*", "*Inbox*")
